title: Repair the copy bounds
prompt: `secondHalf` throws on every input. Diagnose the bound error AND the size error (both off-by-one), fix both, verify {1,2,3} → {3} and {1,2,3,4} → {3,4}.

tests.name: half copied
tests.hint: half = arr.length / 2; out = new int[half]; copy i in 0..half-1 from arr[half + i]. E.g. {1,2,3} -> {2}.
